stage1.prompt: 1. Rank these performance metrics by which drop gives a GM the biggest panic attack (Most Panic to Least):

items.label: RevPAR Index / RGI (Fair market share drop)
Direct Web Channel Share vs OTAs
ADR (Average Daily Rate)
Total Revenue per Available Room (TrevPAR)
Overall Occupancy Percentage

revealStats: #1 RGI / Market Share (Losing to the comp set hurts GM pride most)
#3 Occupancy % (Empty beds are visible to everyone)
#4 Direct Channel Share (High OTA commission sting)
#5 TrevPAR (Ancillary spend usually gets addressed last)

stage1.prompt: 2. Rank these hotel booking lead-time windows by when guests make the most demanding requests:

items.label: Same-Day 11:00 PM walk-in
24 to 48 Hours prior to arrival
7 to 14 Days prior to arrival
1 to 3 Months prior (Standard leisure)
1 Year in advance (Bride / High-stakes event)

revealStats: #1 Same-Day 11 PM ('Can I get a high-floor corner suite for 50€?')
#2 1 Year in advance (Demands every floor plan in PDF)
#3 24–48 Hours out (Sudden flight delay upgrade requests)

stage1.prompt: 3. Rank these BI data nightmares by how painful they are to reconcile on Monday morning:

items.label: Unmapped rate codes dumping revenue into 'Other'
The dreaded #REF! error on row 42,000 of the forecast sheet
Duplicate OTA reservations created during a channel sync lag
PMS midnight rollover failure during monthly close
Someone hardcoding static numbers over your dynamic formulas

revealStats: #1 Hardcoded numbers over live formulas (Unforgivable crime)
#2 PMS midnight rollover crash during month-end
#4 Unmapped rate codes corrupting segment reporting

stage1.prompt: 4. Rank the typical evolution of a Q4 Revenue Forecast file name (From Start to Final Approval):

items.label: Budget_2027_Draft_v1.xlsx
Budget_2027_Realistic_v3.xlsx
Budget_2027_POST_GM_REVIEW_v6.xlsx
Budget_2027_FINAL_v11.xlsx
Budget_2027_FINAL_FINAL_USE_THIS_ONE_v14_ACTUAL.xlsx

revealStats: #3 Post GM Review v6 (The panic adjustments)

stage1.prompt: 5. Rank who is blamed first when a hotel misses its monthly budgeted RevPAR target:

items.label: The Revenue Manager
The Weather / Train Strikes / Airport Delays
The Primary Comp Set dumping rates into the floor
The RMS Algorithm recommendation
Unrealistic Budget targets set by Corporate 11 months ago

revealStats: #1 The Revenue Manager (Always in the hot seat)
#5 Corporate Budget Targets (Nobody admits this out loud)

stage1.prompt: 6. Rank these Accor brands from highest average weekend length-of-stay to shortest:

items.label: Adagio Aparthotels
Fairmont / Raffles Resort properties
Novotel
Mercure
ibis budget (Airport / Transit)

stage1.prompt: 7. Rank the Revenue Manager's holiday wishes (From Dream Scenario to Absolute Disaster):

items.label: 100% ADR surge on New Year's Eve with zero cancellations
Direct web channel bookings surpass OTA commissions
Overbooking model lands at exact 100.0% occupancy with 0 walks
A 50-room corporate group cancels 48 hours prior with no penalty
Front desk accidentally sells the Presidential Suite at ibis budget rates

revealStats: #1 100% ADR surge on NYE (Pure revenue bliss)
#5 Rate parity disaster on luxury inventory

stage1.prompt: 1. Rank the traditional marketing funnel stages by where prospective hotel guests drop off the most (Highest drop-off to Lowest):

items.label: Initial Brand Awareness & Social Discovery
Hotel Property Page Browsing & Room Consideration
Checkout Booking Engine (Payment & Card details)
Post-stay ALL Loyalty program enrollment
Repeat Direct Booking Conversion

revealStats: #1 Top of Funnel Discovery (~90%+ drop-off from initial ad click)
#3 Checkout Engine (Cart abandonment at hidden fees/taxes)

stage1.prompt: 2. Rank these digital marketing ad metrics from most respected by the CFO to pure vanity:

items.label: Direct Booking ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)
Net CPA (Cost Per Acquisition)
E-Commerce Conversion Rate %
Ad Click-Through Rate (CTR)
TikTok & Instagram Video Impressions / Views

revealStats: #1 ROAS (Money in vs. Money out — CFO language)
#5 Social Media Impressions (CFO: 'Can we pay salaries with impressions?')

stage1.prompt: 3. Rank email subject lines by average open rate performance (Highest Open Rate to Instant Delete):

items.label: '[URGENT] Your 15,000 ALL Reward Points are expiring soon'
'Flash Sale: 40% off across Europe for 48 hours only'
'Did you forget something in your basket?' (Abandoned Cart)
'A Holiday Greeting & Note from our CEO'
'Accor Monthly Newsletter: Volume 84 (December)'

revealStats: #1 Points Expiring (~54% Open Rate — Pure panic)
#5 Corporate Letter from the CEO (~7% — Instant archive)

stage1.prompt: 4. Rank the painful lifecycle of an influencer collaboration request (From First Contact to Reality):

items.label: DM arrives: 'Hey love your vibe, let's collab for 3 nights in a suite'
Marketing checks their profile and discovers 82% bought bot followers
Hotel GM forwards the DM with note: 'Can we give them a free stay?'
Marketing politely sends the standard Media Kit & Barter Rate card
Influencer leaves Marketing on 'Read' and never replies

revealStats: #2 The GM excitedly forwarding the DM
#3 Marketing running the follower authenticity audit
#4 Sending the official media rate card

stage1.prompt: 5. Rank loyalty perks by what ALL (Accor Live Limitless) members fight for the hardest:

items.label: Guaranteed Suite Room Upgrade upon arrival
4:00 PM Late Checkout on Sunday
Executive Lounge access (Free evening canapés & wine)
Double Reward Points multiplier
The Welcome Drink voucher at the hotel bar

revealStats: #1 Suite Upgrades (The ultimate holy grail flex)

stage1.prompt: 6. Rank these marketing campaign assets by how long they take to get hotel stakeholder sign-off:

items.label: Global Brand Identity Guidelines overhaul
Legal & GDPR clearance for a customer prize draw
Getting a Hotel GM to approve professional photos of their renovated lobby
Paid Social Media copy translations into 12 languages
A simple 15-second Instagram Story video

revealStats: #1 Hotel GM approving photos ('The cushions aren't fluffed right')

stage1.prompt: 7. Rank the primary reasons a customer abandons the direct hotel booking engine at the final step:

items.label: Unexpected City Tax or Resort Fee added at the final screen
Room type was sold out while filling in personal details
Booking engine requested password for an account they forgot
Went to an OTA (Booking.com) to check if the rate was 2€ cheaper
Payment gateway 3D Secure SMS code failed to arrive

revealStats: #1 Hidden fees & city taxes appearing at checkout
#2 Jumping to OTAs to price-check parity
